comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers come to the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time and pay online or on collection; the order appears in your kitchen. A POS system or card machine takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much is the HatchGrab fee in the country {country}?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract term?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract term and no notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and access continues until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times; customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system calculates from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS system with a TSE?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS system and it has no TSE. How to record online orders in your POS system is a question to ask your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers can pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay in person at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at present.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month} other {The first # months}} free, with all features.
